OpenJDK Vulnerability Advisory: 2026/10/24

The following vulnerabilities in OpenJDK source code were fixed in this release. The affected versions are 27.0.1.0.2, 21.0.13.0.2, 17.0.21.0.2, 11.0.32.1, 8u504, and earlier. We recommend that you upgrade as soon as possible.
